rules.title: Steam could not find your game
rules.message: Sign in with the account that owns Generals or Zero Hour. The Ultimate Collection includes them; Remastered does not. You do not need an extra subscription.

rules.title: The download did not match
rules.message: Retry the installation. If it fails again, check for a launcher update. We keep the previous installation and never bypass the file check.

rules.title: Your computer needs more space
rules.message: Free at least 8 GB for a game or mod, then retry. Your existing installation has been kept.

rules.title: Steam has not finished installing
rules.message: Return to Steam sign-in and repeat the download. Steam checks and repairs the files. Wait for the success message before playing.

rules.title: The graphics runtime needs repair
rules.message: Quit the game, then choose Repair game engine in Help. The launcher restores its verified runtime libraries.

rules.title: Close your current game first
rules.message: Save and quit normally, then retry. The launcher will not replace files while a game is running.

rules.title: Your installation is still running
rules.message: Wait for the download or repair to finish, then play. We keep the game closed while its files are changing.

rules.title: The download server is unavailable
rules.message: Check your internet connection and retry. Verified files are reused, so you will not need to download everything again.

fallback.title: We could not finish that step
fallback.message: Retry once. If it still fails, open Details below and share the error text. Your existing game data remains in place.
